title: Sewing Machine Brands: Singer, Brother, Janome and Juki
description: Guides to the sewing machine brands you meet most in the UK: their history, what each is known for, who their machines suit and how to get parts and servicing.
intro: The history, strengths and best uses of the brands most often found in UK homes, schools and workrooms.

image.alt: Black and white photo of a sewing machine

cardText: History, strengths and who suits each brand: Singer, Brother, Janome, Juki.

sections.h2: Why brand matters less than you think
sections.html: Every major brand makes good and basic machines. What matters most is the model, its build quality, and whether a local dealer can service it. See our brand reviews for Bernina, Pfaff, Jack and Yamato too, and ask a specialist such as PK Sewing Machines which models they can support.
